description.ua: Соковитий мікс салату з вяленою свинною шийкою, запеченим болгарським перцем, свіжим огірком і томатом. Ніжний акцент створює консервований персик, який вдало поєднується з пікантною гірчично-медовою заправкою та стружкою пармезанупоказати
description.en: A juicy salad mix with cured pork neck, roasted bell pepper, fresh cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.de: Ein saftiger Salatmix mit luftgetrocknetem Schweinenacken, gerösteter Paprika, frischer Gurke und Tomate. Eine feine Note bringt der eingelegte Pfirsich, der wunderbar mit einem pikanten Honig-Senf-Dressing und gehobeltem Parmesan harmoniert.
description.fr: A juicy salade mix avec cured porc neck, rôti bell poivron, fresh concombre, et tomate. A gentle accent comes de canned peach, which pairs beautifully avec a piquant honey-mustard dressing et shaved Parmesan.
description.pl: A juicy sałatka mix with cured wieprzowina neck, roasted bell pepper, świeże cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.ro: A juicy salată mix with cured porc neck, roasted bell pepper, proaspăt cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.hu: A szaftos saláta mix val cured sertés tarja, sült bell paprika, friss uborka, és paradicsom. A gentle accent comes ból canned peach, which pairs beautifully val a piquant honey-mustár dressing és shaved Parmesan.
description.bg: Сочен салатен микс със сушен свински врат, печени чушки, прясна краставица и домат. Нежен акцент придава консервираната праскова, която чудесно се съчетава с пикантен медено-горчичен дресинг и люспи пармезан.
description.el: A juicy σαλάτα mix με cured χοιρινό neck, roasted bell pepper, φρέσκο cucumber, και tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully με a piquant honey-mustard dressing και shaved Parmesan.
description.cs: Šťavnatý salátový mix se sušenou vepřovou krkovicí, pečenou paprikou, čerstvou okurkou a rajčetem. Jemný akcent dodává konzervovaná broskev, která skvěle ladí s pikantní medovo-hořčičnou zálivkou a hoblinkami parmazánu.
description.sk: Šťavnatý šalátový mix so sušenou bravčovou krkovičkou, pečenou paprikou, čerstvou uhorkou a paradajkou. Jemný akcent dodáva konzervovaná broskyňa, ktorá skvele ladí s pikantným medovo-horčicovým dressingom a hoblinkami parmezánu.
description.hr: Sočna mješavina salate sa sušenom svinjskom vratinom, pečenom paprikom, svježim krastavcem i rajčicom. Nježan naglasak daje konzervirana breskva, koja se odlično slaže s pikantnim medeno-gorušičnim dressingom i listićima parmezana.
description.it: Un mix di insalata succoso con coppa di maiale essiccata, peperone arrostito, cetriolo fresco e pomodoro. La pesca sciroppata aggiunge un accento delicato che si abbina perfettamente a un dressing piccante al miele e senape e a scaglie di Parmigiano.
description.es: A juicy ensalada mix with cured cerdo neck, roasted bell pepper, fresco cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.nl: Een sappige salademix met gedroogde varkensnek, geroosterde paprika, verse komkommer en tomaat. Een zachte toets van ingemaakte perzik combineert prachtig met een pikante honing-mosterddressing en schilfers Parmezaan.
description.pt: A juicy salada mix with cured porco neck, roasted bell pepper, fresco cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.lt: A sultingas salotos mix with cured kiauliena sprandinė, keptas bell pipiras, šviežias agurkas, and pomidoras. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-garstyčios dressing and shaved Parmesan.
description.lv: Sulīgs salātu maisījums ar vītinātu cūkgaļas kakla karbonādi, ceptu papriku, svaigu gurķi un tomātu. Maigu akcentu piešķir konservēts persiks, kas lieliski sader ar pikantu medus-sinepju mērci un plāni skaidiņās grieztu Parmezānu.
description.sv: En saftig salladsmix med lufttorkad fläskkarré, rostad paprika, färsk gurka och tomat. En mild accent kommer från konserverad persika, som passar utmärkt med en kryddig honungs-senapsdressing och hyvlad parmesan.
description.da: A juicy salat mix with cured svinekød neck, roasted bell pepper, frisk cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan.

fullDescription.en: A juicy salad mix with cured pork neck, roasted bell pepper, fresh cucumber, and tomato. A gentle accent comes from canned peach, which pairs beautifully with a piquant honey-mustard dressing and shaved Parmesan. Balanced in texture and freshness, it works well as a lighter main course or a starter to share.

description.ua: Класика жанру в нашій подільській інтерпретації. Мікс хрумкої зелені, солодкі томати чері, перепелині яйця та хрусткий бекон. Куряче філе, томлене сувідом до ніжності, ми перемащуємо анчоусним соусом і доповнюємо легкою пармезановою еспумою. Відомий смак — у новому, вишуканому прочитанні.показати
description.en: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, sweet cherry tomatoes, quail eggs, and crunchy bacon. Chicken fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated with anchovy sauce and finished with a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined new reading.
description.de: Ein Klassiker in unserer podolischen Interpretation. Eine Mischung aus knackigen Blattsalaten, süßen Cherrytomaten, Wachteleiern und knusprigem Bacon. Das zart sous-vide gegarte Hähnchenfilet wird mit Anchovissauce überzogen und mit einer leichten Parmesan-Espuma vollendet. Ein vertrauter Geschmack in raffinierter Neuinterpretation.
description.fr: Un classique du genre dans notre interpretation podolienne. Un melange de verdures croquantes, de tomates cerises sucrees, d'oeufs de caille et de bacon croustillant. Le filet de poulet cuit sous vide jusqu'a tendrete est nappe de sauce aux anchois et termine par une legere espuma de parmesan. Une saveur familiere dans une lecture raffinee.
description.pl: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, słodkie cherry tomatoes, quail jajka, and crunchy bacon. kurczak fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated with anchovy sos and finished with a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined Nowość reading.
description.ro: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, dulce cherry tomatoes, quail ouă, and crunchy bacon. pui fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated with anchovy sos and finished with a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined Nou reading.
description.hu: A genre klasszikus ban our Podilian interpretation. A mix crisp greens, édes cseresznye paradicsom, quail tojás, és crunchy szalonna. csirke fillet cooked sous-vide until omlós is coated val anchovy szósz és finished val a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor ban a refined Új reading.
description.bg: Жанрова класика в нашия подолски прочит. Микс от хрупкави зелени салати, сладки чери домати, пъдпъдъчи яйца и хрупкав бекон. Пилешкото филе, приготвено sous-vide до крехкост, е покрито с аншоа сос и завършено с лека пармезанова еспума. Познат вкус в изискано ново звучене.
description.el: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, γλυκό cherry tomatoes, quail αυγά, και crunchy bacon. κοτόπουλο fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated με anchovy σάλτσα και finished με a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined new reading.
description.cs: Klasika žánru v našem podolském pojetí. Mix křupavých listů, sladká cherry rajčata, křepelčí vejce a křupavá slanina. Kuřecí filé připravené metodou sous-vide do měkka přeléváme ančovičkovou omáčkou a doplňujeme lehkou parmazánovou espumou. Známá chuť v novém, vytříbeném podání.
description.sk: Klasika žánru v našom podolskom podaní. Mix chrumkavých listov, sladké cherry paradajky, prepeličie vajíčka a chrumkavá slanina. Kuracie filé pripravené metódou sous-vide do mäkka prelievame ančovičkovou omáčkou a dopĺňame ľahkou parmezánovou espumou. Známa chuť v novom, vycibrenom prevedení.
description.hr: Klasik žanra u našoj podolskoj interpretaciji. Mješavina hrskavog lisnatog povrća, slatkih cherry rajčica, prepeličjih jaja i hrskave slanine. Pileći file pripremljen sous-vide do mekoće prelivamo umakom od inćuna i dovršavamo laganom pjenom od parmezana. Poznat okus u novom, profinjenom čitanju.
description.it: Un classico del genere nella nostra interpretazione podolica. Un mix di foglie croccanti, dolci pomodorini cherry, uova di quaglia e bacon croccante. Il filetto di pollo cotto sous-vide fino a risultare tenero viene nappato con salsa di acciughe e completato con una leggera espuma di Parmigiano. Un sapore familiare in una lettura nuova e raffinata.
description.es: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, dulce cherry tomatoes, quail huevos, and crunchy bacon. pollo fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated with anchovy salsa and finished with a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined Nuevo reading.
description.nl: Een genreklassieker in onze Podillische interpretatie. Een mix van knapperige bladeren, zoete cherrytomaten, kwarteleitjes en krokante bacon. Kipfilet sous-vide gegaard tot hij mals is, wordt omhuld met ansjovissaus en afgewerkt met een lichte Parmezaanse espuma. Een vertrouwde smaak in een verfijnde nieuwe uitvoering.
description.pt: A genre classic in our Podilian interpretation. A mix of crisp greens, doce cherry tomatoes, quail ovos, and crunchy bacon. frango fillet cooked sous-vide until tender is coated with anchovy molho and finished with a light Parmesan espuma. A familiar flavor in a refined Novo reading.
description.lt: A genre klasikinis in our Podilian interpretation. A familiar flavor in a refined Nauja reading.
description.lv: Žanra klasika mūsu podiliešu interpretācijā. Kraukšķīgu zaļumu, saldo ķirštomātu, paipalu olu un kraukšķīga bekona maisījums. Sous-vide gatavota vistas fileja līdz maigumam ir pārklāta ar anšovu mērci un pabeigta ar vieglu Parmezāna espumu. Pazīstama garša izsmalcinātā jaunā lasījumā.
description.sv: En genrens klassiker i vår podoliska tolkning. En mix av krispiga blad, söta körsbärstomater, vaktelägg och knaprigt bacon. Kycklingfilé tillagad sous-vide till mörhet täcks med ansjovissås och avslutas med ett lätt parmesanskum. En välbekant smak i en förfinad ny tolkning.

description.ua: Ніжно томлене на низьких температурах волове м’ясо, подане на міксі зелені. Додаємо свіжі огірки, солодкі томати чері та легкий гірчичний соус, приготований на основі домашньої гірчиці. Особливу нотку додає м’ятний заварний крем — несподівано освіжаючий акцент, натхненний подільськими травами.показати
description.en: Tender slow-cooked beef served on a mix of greens. We add fresh cucumbers, sweet cherry tomatoes, and a light mustard sauce made with homemade mustard. A mint custard cream adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.de: Zartes, langsam gegartes Rindfleisch auf einem Mix aus Blattsalaten. Dazu kommen frische Gurken, süße Cherrytomaten und eine leichte Senfsauce aus hausgemachtem Senf. Eine Minzcreme bringt eine unerwartet frische Note, inspiriert von podolischen Kräutern.
description.fr: Tender slow-cooked bœuf served on a mix of greens. We add fresh concombres, sweet cherry tomatees, et a light mustard sauce made avec maison mustard. A mint custard crème adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.pl: Tender slow-cooked wołowina podawane on a mix of greens. We add świeże cucumbers, słodkie cherry tomatoes, and a light mustard sos made with domowe mustard. A mint custard śmietana adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.ro: Tender slow-cooked vită servit on a mix of greens. We add proaspăt cucumbers, dulce cherry tomatoes, and a light mustard sos made with de casă mustard. A mint custard smântână adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.hu: omlós slow-cooked marha tálalva on a mix greens. We add friss cucumbers, édes cseresznye paradicsom, és a light mustár szósz made val házi mustár. A mint custard krém adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.bg: Крехко бавно готвено телешко, поднесено върху микс от зелени салати. Добавяме пресни краставици, сладки чери домати и лек горчичен сос с домашна горчица. Ментовият заварен крем носи неочаквано освежаваща нотка, вдъхновена от подолските билки.
description.el: Tender slow-cooked μοσχάρι σερβίρεται on a mix of greens. We add φρέσκο cucumbers, γλυκό cherry tomatoes, και a light mustard σάλτσα made με σπιτικό mustard. A mint custard κρέμα adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.cs: Jemné pomalu tažené hovězí podáváme na mixu zelených listů. Přidáváme čerstvé okurky, sladká cherry rajčata a lehkou hořčičnou omáčku z domácí hořčice. Mátový jemný krém dodává nečekaně osvěžující tón inspirovaný podolskými bylinkami.
description.sk: Jemné pomaly ťahané hovädzie podávame na mixe zelených listov. Pridávame čerstvé uhorky, sladké cherry paradajky a ľahkú horčicovú omáčku z domácej horčice. Mätový jemný krém dodáva nečakane osviežujúci tón inšpirovaný podolskými bylinkami.
description.hr: Nježnu sporo pirjanu govedinu poslužujemo na mješavini zelenih listova. Dodajemo svježe krastavce, slatke cherry rajčice i lagani umak od gorušice pripremljen s domaćom gorušicom. Mentolna nježna krema daje neočekivano osvježavajuću notu inspiriranu podolskim biljem.
description.it: Tenero manzo cotto lentamente servito su un mix di foglie verdi. Aggiungiamo cetrioli freschi, dolci pomodorini cherry e una leggera salsa di senape preparata con senape fatta in casa. Una delicata crema alla menta dona una nota sorprendentemente fresca ispirata alle erbe podoliche.
description.es: Tender slow-cooked ternera servido on a mix of greens. We add fresco cucumbers, dulce cherry tomatoes, and a light mustard salsa made with casero mustard. A mint custard nata adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.nl: Mals langzaam gegaard rundvlees op een mix van groene bladeren. We voegen verse komkommers, zoete cherrytomaten en een lichte mosterdsaus van huisgemaakte mosterd toe. Een muntige banketbakkersroom geeft een onverwacht frisse noot, ge?nspireerd op Podillische kruiden.
description.pt: Tender slow-cooked vaca servido on a mix of greens. We add fresco cucumbers, doce cherry tomatoes, and a light mustard molho made with caseiro mustard. A mint custard creme adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.lt: minkštas slow-cooked jautiena patiekiama on a mix of greens. We add šviežias cucumbers, saldus vyšnia pomidorai, and a light garstyčios padažas made with naminis garstyčios. A mint custard grietinėlė adds an unexpectedly refreshing note inspired by Podilian herbs.
description.lv: Maiga lēni gatavota liellopa gaļa pasniegta uz zaļumu maisījuma. Pievienojam svaigus gurķus, saldos ķirštomātus un vieglu sinepju mērci no mājas sinepēm. Piparmētru olu krēms piešķir negaidīti atsvaidzinošu noti, ko iedvesmojuši podiliešu augi.

description.en: A light salad mix with cucumber, tomatoes, and creamy avocado, dressed with a delicate yogurt dressing. We finish it with juicy shrimp and aged sheep's Parmino cheese from the village of Chabanivka, a true Podilian delicacy with character.

description.ua: Фірмовий подільський борщ, який томиться на вогні понад 4 години разом із копченою венгеркою, що надає страві глибокого димного аромату. Подається в запашній хлібній мисці. Доповнюється ложкою сметани, свіжою зеленою цибулькою та шматком запеченого шпондеру власного виробництва. Ситна, ароматна й душевна страва — справжній смак Поділля.показати
description.en: Our signature Podilian borscht is simmered over fire for more than four hours together with smoked Hungarian-style sausage, which gives the dish a deep smoky aroma. Served in a fragrant bread bowl and finished with a spoonful of sour cream, fresh green onion, and a piece of our house-made roasted shponder. A hearty, aromatic, soulful dish and a true taste of Podillia.
description.de: Unser Signature-Borschtsch nach podolischer Art köchelt mehr als vier Stunden über dem Feuer zusammen mit geräucherter Wurst im ungarischen Stil, die dem Gericht ein tiefes Raucharoma verleiht. Serviert in einer duftenden Brotschüssel und vollendet mit einem Löffel Sauerrahm, frischer Frühlingszwiebel und einem Stück unseres hausgemacht gebratenen Schponders. Ein herzhaftes, aromatisches und seelenvolles Gericht, der wahre Geschmack Podiliens.

Сервира се в ароматна хлебна купа и се завършва с лъжица заквасена сметана, пресен зелен лук и парче от нашия домашно печен шпондер. Сърцевито, ароматно и душевно ястие, истински вкус на Подолия.

description.cs: Náš podolský boršč se vaří na ohni více než čtyři hodiny spolu s uzenou klobásou po maďarsku, která mu dodává hluboké kouřové aroma. Podává se ve voňavé chlebové misce a doplňuje se lžící zakysané smetany, čerstvou jarní cibulkou a kouskem našeho pečeného šponderu. Syté, voňavé a poctivé jídlo, skutečná chuť Podolí.
description.sk: Náš podolský boršč sa varí na ohni viac než štyri hodiny spolu s údenou klobásou v maďarskom štýle, ktorá mu dodáva hlbokú dymovú arómu. Podáva sa vo voňavej chlebovej miske a dopĺňa sa lyžicou kyslej smotany, čerstvou jarnou cibuľkou a kúskom nášho pečeného šponderu. Sýte, voňavé a poctivé jedlo, skutočná chuť Podolia.
description.hr: Naš podolski boršč kuha se na vatri više od četiri sata zajedno s dimljenom kobasicom u mađarskom stilu, koja mu daje duboku dimnu aromu. Poslužuje se u mirisnoj krušnoj zdjelici i dovršava žlicom kiselog vrhnja, svježim mladim lukom i komadom našeg pečenog špondera. Zasitno, mirisno i iskreno jelo, pravi okus Podolja.
description.it: Il nostro borscht podolico cuoce sul fuoco per più di quattro ore insieme a una salsiccia affumicata in stile ungherese, che dona al piatto un profondo aroma affumicato. Servito in una profumata ciotola di pane e completato con un cucchiaio di panna acida, cipollotto fresco e un pezzo del nostro shponder arrosto. Un piatto sostanzioso, aromatico e pieno d’anima, vero sapore della Podolia.

description.ua: Золотисті деруни, натерті вручну — як у бабусі на селі. Подаються з густим вершковим соусом із лісових грибів. Страва, що гріє душу — проста, щира й по-домашньому смачна.
description.en: Golden hand-grated potato pancakes just like grandma made in the village. Served with a thick creamy forest mushroom sauce. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly homemade.
description.de: Goldene, von Hand geriebene Kartoffelpuffer, genau wie bei der Großmutter auf dem Dorf. Serviert mit einer dicken cremigen Waldpilzsauce. Ein Gericht, das die Seele wärmt, schlicht, ehrlich und wohltuend hausgemacht.
description.fr: Golden hand-grated pomme de terre pancakes just like grandma made dans the village. Servi avec a thick crèmey forest mushroom sauce. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, et comfortingly maison.
description.pl: Golden hand-grated ziemniak pancakes just like grandma made in the village. podawane with a thick creamy forest mushroom sos. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly domowe.
description.ro: Golden hand-grated cartof pancakes just like grandma made in the village. servit with a thick creamy forest mushroom sos. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly de casă.
description.hu: aranyszínű hand-grated burgonya pancakes just like grandma made ban the village. tálalva val a thick creamy forest gomba szósz. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, és comfortingly házi.
description.bg: Златисти картофени палачинки, настъргани на ръка, точно както ги правеше баба на село. Сервират се с гъст кремообразен сос от горски гъби. Ястие, което стопля душата, просто, искрено и уютно домашно.
description.el: Golden hand-grated πατάτα pancakes just like grandma made in the village. σερβίρεται με a thick creamy forest mushroom σάλτσα. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, και comfortingly σπιτικό.
description.cs: Zlatavé bramborové placky ručně strouhané jako od babičky z vesnice. Podává se s hustou smetanovou omáčkou z lesních hub. Jídlo, které zahřeje na duši, jednoduché, poctivé a útulně domácí.
description.sk: Zlatisté zemiakové placky ručne strúhané ako od babičky z dediny. Podáva sa s hustou smotanovou omáčkou z lesných húb. Jedlo, ktoré zahreje na duši, jednoduché, poctivé a útulne domáce.
description.hr: Zlatne krumpirove palačinke ručno ribane, baš kao kod bake na selu. Posluženo uz gusti kremasti umak od šumskih gljiva. Jelo koje grije dušu, jednostavno, iskreno i utješno domaće.
description.it: Dorate frittelle di patate grattugiate a mano proprio come le faceva la nonna in campagna. Servite con una densa salsa cremosa ai funghi di bosco. Un piatto che scalda l’anima, semplice, sincero e confortante come il cibo fatto in casa.
description.es: Golden hand-grated patata pancakes just like grandma made in the village. servido with a thick creamy forest mushroom salsa. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly casero.
description.nl: Gouden met de hand geraspte aardappelpannenkoekjes zoals oma ze in het dorp maakte. Geserveerd met een dikke romige saus van boschampignons. Een gerecht dat de ziel verwarmt: eenvoudig, oprecht en troostrijk huisgemaakt.
description.pt: Golden hand-grated batata pancakes just like grandma made in the village. servido with a thick creamy forest mushroom molho. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly caseiro.
description.lt: auksinis hand-grated bulvė pancakes just like grandma made in the village. patiekiama with a thick creamy forest grybas padažas. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly naminis.
description.lv: Zeltaini ar roku rīvēti kartupeļu plācenīši, gluži kā vecmāmiņa gatavoja ciemā. Pasniegti ar biezu, krēmīgu meža sēņu mērci. Ēdiens, kas sasilda dvēseli, vienkāršs, patiess un mierinoši mājīgs.
description.sv: Gyllene handrivna potatisplättar precis som mormor gjorde i byn. Serveras med en tjock, krämig skogssvampsås. En rätt som värmer själen, enkel, uppriktig och tröstande hemlagad.
description.da: Golden hand-grated kartoffel pancakes just like grandma made in the village. serveres with a thick creamy forest mushroom sauce. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly hjemmelavet.
description.fi: Golden hand-grated peruna pancakes just like grandma made in the village. tarjoillaan with a thick creamy forest mushroom kastike. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly kotitekoinen.
description.et: Golden hand-grated kartul pancakes just like grandma made in the village. serveeritud with a thick creamy forest mushroom kaste. A dish that warms the soul, simple, sincere, and comfortingly kodune.

description.ua: Ніжна яловича щока, повільно томлена до м’якості у глибокому соусі демігляс на основі м’ясного бульйону, овочів та запашних трав. Подається з пухким картопляним пюре, приправленим вершковим маслом. Страва, що поєднує сільську простоту та вишукану техніку приготування — сучасна класика в подільському виконанні.показати
description.en: Tender beef cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from meat broth, vegetables, and fragrant herbs. Served with fluffy mashed potatoes seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.de: Zarte Rinderbacke, langsam geschmort bis zur perfekten Weichheit in einer tiefen Demi-glace aus Fleischbrühe, Gemüse und aromatischen Kräutern. Serviert mit luftigem Kartoffelpüree, verfeinert mit Butter. Ein Gericht, das rustikale Einfachheit mit raffinierter Technik verbindet, ein moderner Klassiker im podolischen Stil.
description.fr: Tender bœuf cheek slowly braised until soft dans a deep demi-glace made de meat broth, vegetables, et fragrant herbs. Servi avec fluffy mashed pommes de terre seasoned avec butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity avec refined technique, a modern classic dans a Podilian style.
description.pl: Tender wołowina cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from mięso broth, warzywa, and fragrant herbs. podawane with fluffy mashed ziemniaki seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.ro: Tender vită cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from carne broth, legume, and fragrant herbs. servit with fluffy mashed cartofi seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.hu: omlós marha cheek slowly braised until soft ban a deep demi-glace made ból hús húsleves, zöldségek, és illatos herbs. tálalva val fluffy püré burgonya seasoned val vaj. A dish that combines rustic simplicity val refined technique, a modern klasszikus ban a Podilian style.
description.bg: Крехка телешка буза, бавно задушена до пълна мекота в плътен демиглас от месен бульон, зеленчуци и ароматни билки. Сервира се с пухкаво картофено пюре, овкусено с масло. Ястие, което съчетава рустикална простота с изискана техника, модерна класика в подолски стил.
description.el: Tender μοσχάρι cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from κρέας broth, λαχανικά, και fragrant herbs. σερβίρεται με fluffy mashed πατάτες seasoned με butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity με refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.cs: Jemné hovězí líčko pomalu dušené do měkka v hluboké demi-glace z masového vývaru, zeleniny a voňavých bylinek. Podává se s nadýchanou bramborovou kaší ochucenou máslem. Pokrm, který spojuje rustikální jednoduchost s vytříbenou technikou, moderní klasika v podolském stylu.
description.sk: Jemné hovädzie líčko pomaly dusené do mäkka v hlbokej demi-glace z mäsového vývaru, zeleniny a voňavých byliniek. Podáva sa s nadýchanou zemiakovou kašou ochutenou maslom. Jedlo, ktoré spája rustikálnu jednoduchosť s vycibrenou technikou, moderná klasika v podolskom štýle.
description.hr: Nježni goveđi obraz polako pirjan do mekoće u dubokom demi-glaceu od mesnog temeljca, povrća i mirisnog bilja. Posluženo uz pahuljasti pire krumpir začinjen maslacem. Jelo koje spaja rustikalnu jednostavnost s profinjenom tehnikom, moderni klasik u podolskom stilu.
description.it: Tenera guancia di manzo brasata lentamente fino a diventare morbida in una profonda demi-glace a base di brodo di carne, verdure ed erbe aromatiche. Servita con soffice purè di patate insaporito con burro. Un piatto che unisce semplicità rustica e tecnica raffinata, un classico moderno in stile podolico.
description.es: Tender ternera cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from carne broth, verduras, and fragrant herbs. servido with fluffy mashed patatas seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.nl: Malse runderwang die langzaam is gestoofd tot hij zacht is in een diepe demi-glace van vleesbouillon, groenten en geurige kruiden. Geserveerd met luchtige aardappelpuree op smaak gebracht met boter. Een gerecht dat rustieke eenvoud combineert met verfijnde techniek, een moderne klassieker in Podillische stijl.
description.pt: Tender vaca cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from carne broth, legumes, and fragrant herbs. servido with fluffy mashed batatas seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.lt: minkštas jautiena cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from mėsa sultinys, daržovės, and kvapnus herbs. patiekiama with fluffy bulvių košė bulvės seasoned with sviestas. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern klasikinis in a Podilian style.
description.lv: Maigs liellopa vaigs lēni sautēts līdz mīkstumam bagātīgā demi-glace no gaļas buljona, dārzeņiem un aromātiskiem zaļumiem. Pasniegts ar gaisīgu kartupeļu biezeni, kas bagātināts ar sviestu. Ēdiens, kas apvieno lauku vienkāršību ar izsmalcinātu tehniku, mūsdienu klasika podiliešu stilā.
description.sv: Mör oxkind som långbräserats tills den blivit mjuk i en djup demi-glace gjord på köttbuljong, grönsaker och aromatiska örter. Serveras med luftigt potatismos smaksatt med smör. En rätt som förenar rustik enkelhet med förfinad teknik, en modern klassiker i podolisk stil.
description.da: Tender oksekød cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from kød broth, grøntsager, and fragrant herbs. serveres with fluffy mashed kartofler seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.fi: Tender naudanliha cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from liha broth, vihannekset, and fragrant herbs. tarjoillaan with fluffy mashed perunat seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.et: Tender veiseliha cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from liha broth, köögiviljad, and fragrant herbs. serveeritud with fluffy mashed kartulid seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.sl: Tender govedina cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from meso broth, zelenjava, and fragrant herbs. postreženo with fluffy mashed krompir seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.ga: Tender mairteoil cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from feoil broth, glasraí, and fragrant herbs. freastailte with fluffy mashed prátaí seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.
description.mt: Tender laħam tal-baqar cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from laħam broth, ħxejjex, and fragrant herbs. servut with fluffy mashed patata seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style.

fullDescription.en: Tender beef cheek slowly braised until soft in a deep demi-glace made from meat broth, vegetables, and fragrant herbs. Served with fluffy mashed potatoes seasoned with butter. A dish that combines rustic simplicity with refined technique, a modern classic in a Podilian style. A hearty main dish designed to showcase Podilian flavors in a more complete plate.

description.de: Zartes Welsfilet, goldbraun gebraten und serviert mit Hirse, die in Sahne zu seidiger Konsistenz gegart wurde. Vollendet mit einer tiefen Fisch-Demi-glace.
description.fr: Tender catpoisson fillet frit to a golden crust et served avec millet cooked dans crème to a silky consistency. Finished avec a deep poisson demi-glace.

description.ua: Карасики добряче солимо, перчимо та обвалюємо в борошні. Засмажуємо на добре розігрітій пательні до "червоного" блиску, подаємо з лимоном. Ідеально поєднується з пивом чи нашим ячмінним самогоном.
description.en: We salt and pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very hot pan to a deep reddish crispness. Served with lemon. Perfect with beer or our barley moonshine.
description.de: Die Karauschen werden großzügig gesalzen und gepfeffert, in Mehl gewendet und in sehr heißer Pfanne zu tief goldener Knusprigkeit gebraten. Serviert mit Zitrone. Perfekt zu Bier oder unserem Gersten-Samogon.
description.fr: We salt et poivron the crucian carp generously, coat them dans flour, et fry them dans a very hot pan to a deep reddish crispness. Servi avec lemon. Perfect avec beer or our barley moonshine.
description.pl: We salt and pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very gorące pan to a deep reddish crispness. podawane with lemon. Perfect with piwo or our barley moonshine.
description.ro: We salt and pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very calde pan to a deep reddish crispness. servit with lemon. Perfect with bere or our barley moonshine.
description.hu: We salt és paprika the crucian carp generously, coat them ban flour, és fry them ban a very meleg pan hoz a deep reddish crispness. tálalva val lemon. Perfect val sör or our barley moonshine.
description.bg: Карасите се осоляват и подправят щедро, овалват се в брашно и се пържат в много горещ тиган до наситено златиста хрупкавост. Сервират се с лимон. Идеални с бира или нашия ечемичен самогон.
description.el: We salt και pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, και fry them in a very καυτό pan to a deep reddish crispness. σερβίρεται με lemon. Perfect με beer or our barley moonshine.
description.cs: Karasy štědře solíme a paprikujeme, obalujeme v mouce a smažíme na velmi rozpálené pánvi do výrazně zlatavé křupavosti. Podává se s citronem. Skvělé k pivu nebo k našemu ječnému měsíčnímu destilátu.
description.sk: Karasy štedro solíme a paprikujeme, obaľujeme v múke a smažíme na veľmi rozpálenej panvici do výraznej zlatavej chrumkavosti. Podáva sa s citrónom. Skvelé k pivu alebo k nášmu jačmennému destilátu.
description.hr: Karase obilno solimo i paprimo, uvaljamo u brašno i pržimo na vrlo vrućoj tavi do izražene zlatno-crvene hrskavosti. Posluženo uz limun. Savršeno uz pivo ili naš ječmeni mjesečev destilat.
description.it: Salamo e condiamo generosamente i carassi con paprika, li infariniamo e li friggiamo in padella molto calda fino a renderli intensamente dorati e croccanti. Serviti con limone. Perfetti con la birra o con il nostro distillato d’orzo.
description.es: We salt and pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very calientes pan to a deep reddish crispness. servido with lemon. Perfect with cerveza or our barley moonshine.
description.nl: We zouten en kruiden de kroeskarpers royaal, halen ze door bloem en bakken ze in een zeer hete pan tot diep roodgoud en krokant. Geserveerd met citroen. Perfect met bier of onze gerstemaneschijn.
description.pt: We salt and pepper the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very quentes pan to a deep reddish crispness. servido with lemon. Perfect with cerveja or our barley moonshine.
description.lt: We salt and pipiras the crucian carp generously, coat them in flour, and fry them in a very karšti pan to a deep reddish crispness. patiekiama with lemon. Perfect with alus or our barley moonshine.
description.lv: Karūsas dāsni sālām un apkaisām ar papriku, apviļājam miltos un cepam ļoti karstā pannā līdz tumši zeltainam kraukšķīgumam. Pasniegtas ar citronu. Lieliski sader ar alu vai mūsu miežu kandžu.
description.sv: Vi saltar och paprikakryddar karaussen generöst, vänder den i mjöl och steker den i en mycket het panna tills den får en djupt rödgyllene krispighet. Serveras med citron. Perfekt till öl eller vår kornsamogon.

description.ua: Традиційний гуцульський бануш на сметані — кремовий, насичений і духмяний. Подається з грибним соусом та щедрою порцією молодої бринзи, що ніжно тане на гарячій кукурудзяній каші. Страва з Карпатським характером, що ідеально пасує до подільського столу.показати
description.en: Traditional Hutsul banush made with sour cream, creamy, rich, and fragrant. Served with mushroom sauce and a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the hot corn porridge. A dish with Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.de: Traditioneller hutsulischer Banusch mit Sauerrahm, cremig, reichhaltig und aromatisch. Serviert mit Pilzsauce und einer großzügigen Portion junger Bryndza, die sanft über dem heißen Maisbrei schmilzt. Ein Gericht mit karpatischem Charakter, das perfekt auf einen podolischen Tisch passt.
description.fr: Traditional Hutsul banush made avec sour crème, crèmey, rich, et fragrant. Servi avec mushroom sauce et a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the hot corn porridge. A dish avec Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.pl: Traditional Hutsul banush made with sour śmietana, creamy, rich, and fragrant. podawane with mushroom sos and a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the gorące corn porridge. A dish with Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.ro: Traditional Hutsul banush made with sour smântână, creamy, rich, and fragrant. servit with mushroom sos and a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the calde corn porridge. A dish with Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.hu: Traditional Hutsul banush made val sour krém, creamy, rich, és illatos. tálalva val gomba szósz és a generous portion young bryndza that melts delicately over the meleg corn porridge. A dish val Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.bg: Традиционен хуцулски бануш, приготвен със заквасена сметана, кремообразен, плътен и ароматен. Сервира се с гъбен сос и щедра порция млада бриндза, която се разтапя нежно върху горещата царевична каша. Ястие с карпатски характер, което идеално подхожда на подолска трапеза.
description.el: Traditional Hutsul banush made με sour κρέμα, creamy, rich, και fragrant. σερβίρεται με mushroom σάλτσα και a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the καυτό corn porridge. A dish με Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.cs: Tradiční huculský banush připravený ze zakysané smetany, bohatý a voňavý. Podává se s houbovou omáčkou a štědrou porcí mladé brynzy, která se jemně rozpouští na horké kukuřičné kaši. Jídlo s karpatským charakterem, které se na podolský stůl hodí dokonale.
description.sk: Tradičný huculský banuš pripravený z kyslej smotany, bohatý a voňavý. Podáva sa s hubovou omáčkou a štedrou porciou mladej bryndze, ktorá sa jemne rozpúšťa na horúcej kukuričnej kaši. Jedlo s karpatským charakterom, ktoré sa na podolský stôl hodí dokonale.
description.hr: Tradicionalni huculski banuš pripremljen s kiselim vrhnjem, bogat i mirisan. Posluženo uz umak od gljiva i obilnu porciju mlade bryndze koja se nježno topi preko vruće kukuruzne kaše. Jelo s karpatskim karakterom koje savršeno pristaje podolskom stolu.
description.it: Tradizionale banush hutsulo preparato con panna acida, ricco e profumato. Servito con salsa ai funghi e un’abbondante porzione di giovane bryndza che si scioglie delicatamente sulla polenta di mais calda. Un piatto dal carattere carpatico che si adatta perfettamente a una tavola podolica.
description.es: Traditional Hutsul banush made with sour nata, creamy, rich, and fragrant. servido with mushroom salsa and a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the calientes corn porridge. A dish with Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly.
description.nl: Traditionele Hutsulse banush gemaakt met zure room, romig, rijk en geurig. Geserveerd met champignonsaus en een royale portie jonge bryndza die zacht smelt over de hete ma?spap. Een gerecht met Karpatisch karakter dat perfect past op een Podillische tafel.

fullDescription.en: Traditional Hutsul banush made with sour cream, creamy, rich, and fragrant. Served with mushroom sauce and a generous portion of young bryndza that melts delicately over the hot corn porridge. A dish with Carpathian character that suits a Podilian table perfectly. description.cs: Domácí vareniky s nadýchaným těstem a bramborovou náplní, podávané se zlatavou smaženou cibulkou, křupavými škvarky a bezinkovými kapary, které dodávají jemnou kyselost. Dokončeno štědrou lžící zakysané smetany. Podolská klasika s nečekaným dotekem, známá chuť v novém podání.

Completati con un generoso cucchiaio di panna acida. Un classico podolico con un tocco inatteso, un sapore familiare in una nuova veste.
description.es: casero varenyky with fluffy dough and a patata filling, servido with golden frito cebolla, crispy cracklings, and elderflower capers that add a gentle tang. description.en: House-made varenyky with juicy cherry, tender dough, a generous filling, and a real summer mood. Served with an aromatic sauce based on condensed milk, sour cream, and cinnamon. description.de: Hausgemachte Wareniki mit saftigen Kirschen, zartem Teig, großzügiger Füllung und echtem Sommergefühl. Serviert mit einer aromatischen Sauce aus Kondensmilch, Sauerrahm und Zimt. Bestreut mit zerstoßenen Haselnüssen und frischer Minze. Ein leichtes süßes Gericht, das besonders Kinder begeistert. Kann Kerne enthalten.
description.fr: House-made varenyky avec juicy cherry, tender dough, a generous filling, et a real summer mood. Servi avec an aromatic sauce based on condensed milk, sour crème, et cinnamon. description.bg: Домашни вареники със сочни череши, нежно тесто, щедра плънка и истинско лятно настроение. Сервират се с ароматен сос от кондензирано мляко, заквасена сметана и канела. Поръсени са с натрошени лешници и прясна мента. Леко сладко ястие, което особено радва децата. Може да съдържа костилки.

description.cs: Domácí vareniky se šťavnatou višní, jemným těstem a bohatou náplní, s opravdovou letní náladou. Podává se s voňavou omáčkou z kondenzovaného mléka, zakysané smetany a skořice. Posypáno drcenými lískovými ořechy a čerstvou mátou. Lehký sladký pokrm, který potěší hlavně děti. Může obsahovat pecky.
description.sk: Domáce vareniky so šťavnatou višňou, jemným cestom a bohatou plnkou, s pravou letnou náladou. Podáva sa s voňavou omáčkou z kondenzovaného mlieka, kyslej smotany a škorice. Posypané drvenými lieskovými orechmi a čerstvou mätou. Ľahké sladké jedlo, ktoré poteší najmä deti. Môže obsahovať kôstky.
description.hr: Domaći vareniki sa sočnom višnjom, nježnim tijestom i bogatim nadjevom, s pravim ljetnim raspoloženjem. Posluženo uz mirisni umak od kondenziranog mlijeka, kiselog vrhnja i cimeta. Posuto drobljenim lješnjacima i svježom mentom. Lagano slatko jelo koje posebno veseli djecu. Može sadržavati koštice.
description.it: Varenyky fatti in casa con succosa visciola, impasto tenero e ripieno generoso, con una vera atmosfera estiva. Serviti con una salsa profumata a base di latte condensato, panna acida e cannella. Cosparsi di nocciole tritate e menta fresca. Un dolce leggero che conquista soprattutto i bambini. Può contenere noccioli.
description.es: House-made varenyky with juicy cherry, tender dough, a generous filling, and a real summer mood. servido with an aromatic salsa based on condensed leche, sour nata, and cinnamon. Kan pitten bevatten.

description.ua: Ніжні солодкі галушки з вишнею, политі соусом з вершків, сметани та згущеного молока — ніжним і кремовим, як у дитинстві. Посипаються какао-крихтою та дробленим ліщином для балансу смаку й текстури. Улюблений десерт дітей (і не тільки!). Допускається наявність кісточок у вишнях.показати
description.en: Tender sweet galushky with cherry, covered with a sauce of cream, sour cream, and condensed milk, gentle and creamy like childhood. Sprinkled with cocoa crumble and crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor and texture. A favorite dessert for children and not only. Cherry pits may occur.
description.de: Zarte süße Galuschki mit Kirschen, überzogen mit einer Sauce aus Sahne, Sauerrahm und Kondensmilch, sanft und cremig wie die Kindheit. Bestreut mit Kakao-Crumble und zerstoßenen Haselnüssen für ein ausgewogenes Spiel von Geschmack und Textur. Ein Lieblingsdessert für Kinder und Erwachsene. Kirschkerne können enthalten sein.
description.fr: Tender sweet galushky avec cherry, covered avec a sauce of crème, sour crème, et condensed milk, gentle et crèmey like childhood. Sprinkled avec cocoa crumble et crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor et texture. A favorite dessert for children et not only. Cherry pits may occur.
description.pl: Tender słodkie galushky with cherry, covered with a sos of śmietana, sour śmietana, and condensed mleko, gentle and creamy like childhood. Sprinkled with cocoa crumble and crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor and texture. A favorite dessert for children and not only. Cherry pits may occur.
description.ro: Tender dulce galushky with cherry, covered with a sos of smântână, sour smântână, and condensed lapte, gentle and creamy like childhood. Sprinkled with cocoa crumble and crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor and texture. A favorite dessert for children and not only. Cherry pits may occur.
description.hu: omlós édes galushky val cseresznye, covered val a szósz krém, sour krém, és condensed tej, gentle és creamy like childhood. Sprinkled val cocoa crumble és crushed hazelnuts hoz balance flavor és texture. A favorite dessert hoz children és not only. cseresznye pits may occur.
description.bg: Нежни сладки галушки с череши, покрити със сос от сметана, заквасена сметана и кондензирано мляко, нежен и кремообразен като детството. Поръсени с какаови трохи и натрошени лешници за баланс на вкуса и текстурата. Любим десерт за деца и не само. Може да съдържа костилки от череши.
description.el: Tender γλυκό galushky με cherry, covered με a σάλτσα of κρέμα, sour κρέμα, και condensed γάλα, gentle και creamy like childhood. Sprinkled με cocoa crumble και crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor και texture. A favorite dessert for children και not only. Cherry pits may occur.
description.cs: Jemné sladké halušky s višní, přelité omáčkou ze smetany, zakysané smetany a kondenzovaného mléka, jemné a krémové jako dětství. Posypané kakaovou drobenkou a drcenými lískovými ořechy pro rovnováhu chuti i textury. Oblíbený dezert pro děti i dospělé. Může obsahovat pecky.
description.sk: Jemné sladké halušky s višňou, preliate omáčkou zo smotany, kyslej smotany a kondenzovaného mlieka, jemné a krémové ako detstvo. Posypané kakaovou posýpkou a drvenými lieskovými orechmi pre rovnováhu chuti aj textúry. Obľúbený dezert pre deti aj dospelých. Môže obsahovať kôstky.
description.hr: Nježne slatke haluške s višnjom, prelivene umakom od vrhnja, kiselog vrhnja i kondenziranog mlijeka, nježne i kremaste kao djetinjstvo. Posute kakao mrvicama i drobljenim lješnjacima za ravnotežu okusa i teksture. Omiljeni desert za djecu i odrasle. Može sadržavati koštice.
description.it: Tenere galushky dolci con visciola, coperte da una salsa di panna, panna acida e latte condensato, delicate e cremose come l’infanzia. Cosparse di crumble al cacao e nocciole tritate per un perfetto equilibrio di gusto e consistenza. Un dessert amato da bambini e adulti. Può contenere noccioli.

Sprinkled with cocoa crumble and crushed hazelnuts for balance of flavor and texture. A favorite dessert for children and not only. Cherry pits may occur.

description.ua: Щедра м’ясна добірка з печі: соковитий свинний шашлик, ніжний курячий шашлик, запашне свинне ребро та подільська ковбаса власного виробництва. Подається з салатом із капусти в оцтово-гірчичній заправці, двома свіжоспеченими паляницями, домашньою аджикою, соусом на основі ряжанки, маринованою цибулькою та зеленню. Страва для компанії — щедра, запашна та справжньо подільська.показати
description.en: A generous meat assortment from the oven: juicy pork shashlik, tender chicken shashlik, fragrant pork rib, and Podilian house-made sausage. Served with cabbage salad in a vinegar-mustard dressing, two freshly baked flatbreads, homemade adjika, a ryazhanka-based sauce, pickled onion, and herbs. description.cs: Cena je uvedena za hmotnost, konkrétně za 100 g. Šťavnatá vepřová žebra pomalu tažená v peci do měkka, poté štědře glazovaná voňavou barbecue omáčkou pro bohatou sladko-pikantní chuť. Podává se s domácí adjikou, čerstvými bylinkami a čerstvě pečenou žitnou plackou. Jídlo pro opravdové milovníky masa.
description.sk: Cena je podľa hmotnosti, uvedená za 100 g. Šťavnaté bravčové rebrá pomaly ťahané v peci do mäkka, potom štedro glazované voňavou barbecue omáčkou pre bohatú sladko-pikantnú chuť. Podáva sa s domácou adjikou, čerstvými bylinkami a čerstvo pečenou ražnou plackou. Jedlo pre skutočných milovníkov mäsa.
description.hr: Cijena je prema težini, prikazana za 100 g. Sočna svinjska rebra polako pirjana u peći do mekoće, zatim obilno glazirana mirisnim barbecue umakom za bogat slatko-pikantan okus. Posluženo uz domaću adjiku, svježe začinsko bilje i svježe pečenu raženu pogaču. Jelo za prave ljubitelje mesa.
description.it: Prezzo al peso, indicato per 100 g. Succose costine di maiale brasate lentamente nel forno fino a diventare tenere, poi generosamente glassate con salsa barbecue aromatica per un gusto ricco, dolce e piccante. Servite con adjika fatta in casa, erbe fresche e focaccia di segale appena sfornata. Un piatto per veri amanti della carne.
description.es: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy cerdo ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue salsa for a rich dulce-and-picante flavor. servido with casero adjika, fresco herbs, and freshly horneado rye flatbread. A dish for true carne lovers.
description.nl: Prijs per gewicht, weergegeven per 100 g. Sappige varkensribben langzaam gestoofd in de oven tot ze mals zijn en daarna royaal gelakt met aromatische barbecuesaus voor een rijke zoet-pittige smaak. Geserveerd met huisgemaakte adjika, verse kruiden en vers gebakken roggeflatbread. Een gerecht voor echte vleesliefhebbers.
description.pt: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy porco ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue molho for a rich doce-and-picante flavor. servido with caseiro adjika, fresco herbs, and freshly assado rye flatbread. A dish for true carne lovers.
description.lt: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. sultingas kiauliena ribs slowly braised in the krosnis until minkštas, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue padažas for a rich saldus-and-Aštru flavor. patiekiama with naminis adjika, šviežias herbs, and freshly keptas rye flatbread. A dish for true mėsa lovers.
description.lv: Cena norādīta pēc svara, par 100 g. Sulīgas cūkgaļas ribiņas lēni sautētas krāsnī līdz maigumam, pēc tam dāsni glazētas ar aromātisku bārbekjū mērci bagātīgai saldi pikantai garšai. Pasniegtas ar mājas adžiku, svaigiem zaļumiem un svaigi ceptu rudzu plāceņmaizi. Ēdiens īstiem gaļas cienītājiem.
description.sv: Priset anges per vikt, per 100 g. Saftiga fläskrevben långbräseras i ugnen tills de är möra och glaseras sedan generöst med aromatisk barbecuesås för en rik sötstark smak. Serveras med hemlagad adjika, färska örter och nybakat rågflatbröd. En rätt för riktiga köttälskare.
description.da: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy svinekød ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue sauce for a rich sød-and-stærk flavor. serveres with hjemmelavet adjika, frisk herbs, and freshly bagt rye flatbread. A dish for true kød lovers.
description.fi: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy sianliha ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue kastike for a rich makea-and-mausteinen flavor. tarjoillaan with kotitekoinen adjika, tuore herbs, and freshly paistettu rye flatbread. A dish for true liha lovers.
description.et: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy sealiha ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue kaste for a rich magus-and-vürtsikas flavor. serveeritud with kodune adjika, värske herbs, and freshly küpsetatud rye flatbread. A dish for true liha lovers.
description.sl: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy svinjina ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue omaka for a rich sladko-and-pikantno flavor. postreženo with domače adjika, sveže herbs, and freshly pečeno rye flatbread. A dish for true meso lovers.
description.ga: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. A dish for true feoil lovers.

A dish for true laħam lovers.

fullDescription.en: Priced by weight, with the price shown per 100 g. Juicy pork ribs slowly braised in the oven until tender, then generously glazed with aromatic barbecue sauce for a rich sweet-and-spicy flavor. Served with homemade adjika, fresh herbs, and freshly baked rye flatbread. A dish for true meat lovers. The oven and open-fire character bring extra depth, smokiness, and warmth to the dish.

description.ua: Соковите м’ясо курячого стегна, мариноване у спеціях та запечене на вугіллі до золотистої скоринки й легкого аромату диму. Подається з м’якою пшеничною паляницею, ніжним соусом на основі ряжанки та свіжою зеленнюпоказати
description.en: Juicy chicken thigh meat marinated in spices and roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a light smoky aroma. Served with soft wheat flatbread, a delicate ryazhanka-based sauce, and fresh herbs.
description.de: Saftiges Hähnchenschenkelfleisch, in Gewürzen mariniert und über Holzkohle geröstet, bis es eine goldene Kruste und ein leicht rauchiges Aroma bekommt. Serviert mit weichem Weizenfladenbrot, einer feinen Sauce auf Ryazhanka-Basis und frischen Kräutern.
description.fr: Juicy poulet thigh meat marinated dans spices et rôti over charcoal to a golden crust et a light smoky aroma. Servi avec soft wheat flatpain, a delicate ryazhanka-based sauce, et fresh herbs.

description.ro: Juicy pui thigh carne marinated in spices and roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a light smoky aroma. servit with soft wheat flatbread, a delicate ryazhanka-based sos, and proaspăt herbs.
description.hu: szaftos csirke thigh hús marinated ban spices és sült over charcoal hoz a aranyszínű crust és a light smoky aroma. tálalva val soft wheat flatbread, a finom ryazhanka-based szósz, és friss herbs.
description.bg: Сочно пилешко бутче, мариновано с подправки и изпечено на въглища до златиста коричка и лек пушен аромат. Сервира се с мек пшеничен плосък хляб, деликатен сос на основата на ряженка и пресни билки.
description.el: Juicy κοτόπουλο thigh κρέας marinated in spices και roasted over charcoal to a golden crust και a light smoky aroma. σερβίρεται με soft wheat flatbread, a delicate ryazhanka-based σάλτσα, και φρέσκο herbs.
description.cs: Šťavnaté kuřecí stehenní maso marinované v koření a pečené na uhlí do zlatavé kůrky s lehkým kouřovým aroma. Podává se s měkkou pšeničnou plackou, jemnou omáčkou na bázi rjaženky a čerstvými bylinkami.
description.sk: Šťavnaté kuracie stehenné mäso marinované v korení a pečené na uhlí do zlatistej kôrky s ľahkou dymovou arómou. Podáva sa s mäkkou pšeničnou plackou, jemnou omáčkou na báze rjaženky a čerstvými bylinkami.
description.hr: Sočno pileće meso od buta marinirano u začinima i pečeno na ugljenu do zlatne korice s blagom dimnom aromom. Posluženo uz mekanu pšeničnu pogaču, nježni umak na bazi rjaženke i svježe začinsko bilje.
description.it: Succosa carne di coscia di pollo marinata nelle spezie e arrostita sulla brace fino a una crosta dorata con una leggera nota affumicata. Servita con morbida focaccia di grano, delicata salsa a base di rjaženka ed erbe fresche.
description.es: Juicy pollo thigh carne marinated in spices and roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a light smoky aroma. servido with soft wheat flatbread, a delicate ryazhanka-based salsa, and fresco herbs.
description.nl: Sappig kipdijvlees gemarineerd in specerijen en geroosterd boven houtskool tot een goudbruine korst en een licht rokerig aroma. Geserveerd met zacht tarweflatbread, een delicate saus op basis van ryazhanka en verse kruiden.
description.pt: Juicy frango thigh carne marinated in spices and roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a light smoky aroma. servido with soft wheat flatbread, a delicate ryazhanka-based molho, and fresco herbs.
description.lt: sultingas vištiena thigh mėsa marinated in spices and keptas over charcoal to a auksinis crust and a light smoky aroma. patiekiama with soft wheat flatbread, a švelnus ryazhanka-based padažas, and šviežias herbs.
description.lv: Sulīga vistas šķiņķa gaļa, marinēta garšvielās un cepta uz oglēm līdz zeltainai garoziņai un vieglam dūmu aromātam. Pasniegta ar mīkstu kviešu plāceņmaizi, maigu rjažankas mērci un svaigiem zaļumiem.
description.sv: Saftigt kycklinglårkött marinerat i kryddor och rostat över kol till gyllene yta och lätt rökig arom. Serveras med mjukt veteflatbröd, en mild sås baserad på ryazhanka och färska örter.

description.fr: Juicy porc neck rôti over charcoal to a browned crust et tender center. Served on freshly cuit au four rye flatpain avec maison adjika, fragrant herbs, et mariné onion.
description.pl: Juicy wieprzowina neck roasted over charcoal to a browned crust and tender center. podawane on freshly pieczone rye flatbread with domowe adjika, fragrant herbs, and pickled cebula.

description.ua: Соковита свинна шия, запечена на вугіллі до золотистої скоринки й насиченого аромату диму. Подається з ніжною картоплею Анна, запеченою шарами у вершковому маслі, та маринованою цибулею. Завершує страву вишуканий соус із копчених слив, що додає солодко-кислий акцент і підкреслює смак м’яса.показати
description.en: Juicy pork neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a rich smoky aroma. Served with delicate Anna potatoes baked in buttery layers and pickled onion. Finished with an elegant smoked plum sauce that adds a sweet-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the meat.
description.de: Saftiger Schweinenacken, über Holzkohle geröstet bis zu einer goldenen Kruste und reichem Raucharoma. Serviert mit feinen Anna-Kartoffeln, in buttrigen Schichten gebacken, und eingelegten Zwiebeln. Vollendet mit einer eleganten geräucherten Pflaumensauce, die eine süß-saure Note setzt und den Fleischgeschmack hervorhebt.
description.fr: Juicy porc neck rôti over charcoal to a golden crust et a rich smoky aroma. Servi avec delicate Anna pommes de terre cuit au four dans buttery layers et mariné onion. Finished avec an elegant fumé plum sauce that adds a sweet-and-sour accent et highlights the flavor of the meat.
description.pl: Juicy wieprzowina neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a rich smoky aroma. podawane with delicate Anna ziemniaki pieczone in buttery layers and pickled cebula. Finished with an elegant smoked plum sos that adds a słodkie-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the mięso.
description.ro: Juicy porc neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a rich smoky aroma. servit with delicate Anna cartofi copt in buttery layers and pickled ceapă. Finished with an elegant smoked plum sos that adds a dulce-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the carne.
description.hu: szaftos sertés tarja sült over charcoal hoz a aranyszínű crust és a rich smoky aroma. tálalva val finom Anna burgonya sült ban buttery layers és savanyított hagyma. Finished val an elegant smoked plum szósz that adds a édes-és-sour accent és highlights the flavor the hús.
description.bg: Сочен свински врат, изпечен на въглища до златиста коричка и богат пушен аромат. Сервира се с деликатни картофи Анна, изпечени на маслени пластове, и маринован лук. Завършен е с елегантен сос от пушени сливи, който добавя сладко-кисел акцент и подчертава вкуса на месото.
description.el: Juicy χοιρινό neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust και a rich smoky aroma. σερβίρεται με delicate Anna πατάτες ψημένο in buttery layers και pickled κρεμμύδι. Finished με an elegant smoked plum σάλτσα that adds a γλυκό-και-sour accent και highlights the flavor of the κρέας.
description.cs: Šťavnatá vepřová krkovice pečená na uhlí do zlatavé kůrky s bohatým kouřovým aroma. Podává se s jemnými bramborami Anna pečenými v máslových vrstvách a nakládanou cibulí. Dokončeno elegantní omáčkou z uzených švestek, která dodává sladkokyselý akcent a zvýrazňuje chuť masa.
description.sk: Šťavnatá bravčová krkovička pečená na uhlí do zlatistej kôrky s bohatou dymovou arómou. Podáva sa s jemnými zemiakmi Anna pečenými v maslových vrstvách a nakladanou cibuľou. Dokončené elegantnou omáčkou z údených sliviek, ktorá dodáva sladkokyslý akcent a zvýrazňuje chuť mäsa.
description.hr: Sočna svinjska vratina pečena na ugljenu do zlatne korice i bogate dimne arome. Posluženo uz nježni krumpir Anna pečen u slojevima maslaca i ukiseljeni luk. Dovršeno elegantnim umakom od dimljenih šljiva koji daje slatko-kiseli naglasak i ističe okus mesa.
description.it: Succosa coppa di maiale arrostita sulla brace fino a una crosta dorata e a un ricco aroma affumicato. Servita con delicate patate Anna cotte al forno in strati burrosi e cipolla marinata. Completata con un’elegante salsa di prugne affumicate che aggiunge un accento agrodolce ed esalta il sapore della carne.
description.es: Juicy cerdo neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a rich smoky aroma. servido with delicate Anna patatas horneado in buttery layers and pickled cebolla. Finished with an elegant smoked plum salsa that adds a dulce-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the carne.
description.nl: Sappige varkensnek geroosterd boven houtskool tot een goudbruine korst en een rijk rokerig aroma. Geserveerd met delicate Anna-aardappelen gebakken in boterige laagjes en ingelegde ui. Afgewerkt met een elegante gerookte pruimensaus die een zoetzuur accent toevoegt en de vleessmaak benadrukt.
description.pt: Juicy porco neck roasted over charcoal to a golden crust and a rich smoky aroma. servido with delicate Anna batatas assado in buttery layers and pickled cebola. Finished with an elegant smoked plum molho that adds a doce-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the carne.
description.lt: sultingas kiauliena sprandinė keptas over charcoal to a auksinis crust and a rich smoky aroma. patiekiama with švelnus Anna bulvės keptas in buttery layers and marinuotas svogūnas. Finished with an elegant smoked plum padažas that adds a saldus-and-sour accent and highlights the flavor of the mėsa.
description.lv: Sulīga cūkgaļas kakla karbonāde, cepta uz oglēm līdz zeltainai garoziņai un bagātīgam dūmu aromātam.
